# tere

The goal of tere is to support kaimahi at Auckland Council when they
work with the R programming language.

## Installation

You can install the development version of tere from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Auckland-Council-CC-Insights-Team/tere")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to quickly read an Excel
file:

``` r

library(tere)
get_excel_file("my_excel_file", "sheet_name")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bind_dataframes()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/bind_dataframes.md)
  : Name And Bind Dataframes
- [`check_file_properties()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/check_file_properties.md)
  : Check File Properties
- [`connect_to_sharepoint()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/connect_to_sharepoint.md)
  : Connect To A SharePoint Site
- [`create_environment_variable()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/create_environment_variable.md)
  : Create a .Renviron file that points to your locally-synchronised
  SharePoint Document Library
- [`fy_to_date()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/fy_to_date.md)
  : Convert a Financial Year To A Date
- [`get_excel_file()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/get_excel_file.md)
  : Efficiently read an Excel file
- [`get_file_name()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/get_file_name.md)
  : Get The Names Of Files In A Folder
- [`get_file_properties()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/get_file_properties.md)
  : Get File Properties
- [`get_file_storage_path()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/get_file_storage_path.md)
  : Retrieve the full path to the local SharePoint directory where your
  team's files are stored
- [`get_list_items()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/get_list_items.md)
  : Retrieve SharePoint List Items
- [`read_file()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/read_file.md)
  : Read Files
- [`update_list_items()`](https://auckland-council-cc-insights-team.github.io/tere/reference/update_list_items.md)
  : Update SharePoint List Items
